name: Fizzy Grapes
desc: Seedless grapes carbonated in a soda siphon so they pop and fizz when you bite them.

source.title: Fizzy Grapes
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 2 cups seedless grapes (about 32), or other small firm fruit, chilled
ingredients.note: about 32, or other small firm fruit

ingredients.raw: 1 (1 pint / 500 ml) soda siphon or whipped cream dispenser

steps: Wash the grapes, pat them completely dry and chill them.
Put the grapes in the siphon, screw the lid on tightly and charge with 2 CO2 chargers, one at a time.
Refrigerate the siphon for at least 4 hours so the gas dissolves into the fruit.

Hold the siphon upright and press the lever slowly to release all of the gas. Once it stops hissing, unscrew the lid, pour the grapes into a bowl and serve immediately. The fizz fades within about 15 minutes.
tips: Grapes swell after carbonating, so use fruit a bit smaller than the canister opening or they get stuck.
Use CO2 soda chargers. N2O whipped cream chargers will not make the fruit fizzy.
Studio Kitchen adds 200 g sparkling wine to the siphon with the grapes for a boozy version; drain the wine off before opening.

references.title: Fizzy Grapes
references.usedFor: grape count for a 500 ml siphon, 2 CO2 chargers, 4 hour fridge time, sparkling wine variation
